sn22.82:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati pubbārāme migāramātupāsāde mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ.
sn22.82:1.2: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā tadahuposathe paṇṇarase puṇṇāya puṇṇamāya rattiyā bhikkhusaṅghaparivuto ajjhokāse nisinno hoti.
sn22.82:2.1: atha kho aññataro bhikkhu uṭṭhāyāsanā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā yena bhagavā tenañjalimpaṇāmetvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn22.82:2.2: puccheyyāhaṃ bhante bhagavantaṃ kiñci deva desaṃ sace me bhagavā okāsaṃ karoti pañhassa veyyākaraṇāyāti.
sn22.82:2.3: tenahi tvaṃ bhikkhu sake āsane nisīditvā puccha yadākaṅkhasīti.
sn22.82:2.4: evaṃ bhanteti kho so bhikkhu bhagavato paṭissutvā sake āsane nisīditvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn22.82:2.5: ime nu kho bhante pañcupādānakkhandhā. seyyathīdaṃ.
sn22.82:3.3: sādhu bhanteti kho so bhikkhu bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā bhagavantaṃ uttariṃ pañhaṃ apucchi
sn22.82:4.1: ime kho pana bhante pañcupādānakkhandhā kiṃmūlakāti.
sn22.82:4.3: taññeva nu kho bhante upādānaṃ te ca pañcupādānakkhandhā. udāhu aññatra pañcahi upādānakkhandhehi upādānanti.
sn22.82:4.4: na kho bhikkhu taññeva upādānaṃ te ca pañcupādānakkhandhā napi aññatra pañcahi upādānakkhandhehi upādānaṃ apica yo tattha chandarāgo taṃ tattha upādānanti.
sn22.82:4.5: sādhu bhanteti kho so bhikkhu …pe… uttariṃ pañhaṃ apucchi
sn22.82:5.4: evaṃrūpo siyaṃ anāgatamaddhānaṃ evaṃvedano siyaṃ anāgatamaddhānaṃ evaṃsañaño siyaṃ anāgatamaddhānaṃ evaṃsaṅkhāro siyaṃ anāgatamaddhānaṃ evaṃviññāṇo siyaṃ anāgatamaddhānanti.
sn22.82:5.5: evaṃ kho bhikkhu siyā pañcupādānakkhandhesu chandarāgavemattatāti.
sn22.82:5.6: sādhu bhanteti kho so bhikkhu …pe… uttariṃ pañhaṃ apucchi
sn22.82:6.1: kittāvatā nu kho bhante khandhānaṃ khandhādhivacananti.
sn22.82:6.2: yaṅkiñci bhikkhu rūpaṃ atītānāgatapaccuppannaṃ ajjhattaṃ vā bahiddhā vā oḷārikaṃ vā sukhumaṃ vā hīnaṃ vā paṇītaṃ vā yaṃ dūre santike vā. ayaṃ vuccati rūpakkhandho.
sn22.82:6.6: yaṅkiñci viññāṇaṃ atītānāgatapaccuppannaṃ ajjhattaṃ vā bahiddhā vā oḷārikaṃ vā sukhumaṃ vā hīnaṃ vā paṇītaṃ vā yaṃ dūre santike vā. ayaṃ vuccati viññāṇakkhandho.
sn22.82:6.8: sādhu bhanteti kho so bhikkhu …pe… apucchi
sn22.82:7.1: ko nu kho bhante hetu ko paccayo rūpakkhandhassa paññāpanāya.
sn22.82:7.2: ko hetu ko paccayo vedanākkhandhassa paññāpanāya.
sn22.82:7.3: ko hetu ko paccayo saññākkhandhassa paññāpanāya.
sn22.82:7.4: ko hetu ko paccayo saṅkhārakkhandhassa paññāpanāya.
sn22.82:7.5: ko hetu ko paccayo viññāṇakkhandhassa paññāpanāyāti.
sn22.82:7.6: cattāro kho bhikkhu mahābhūtā hetu cattāro mahābhūtā paccayo rūpakkhandhassa paññāpanāya.
sn22.82:7.7: phasso hetu phasso paccayo vedanākkhandhassa paññāpanāya.
sn22.82:7.8: phasso hetu phasso paccayo saññākkhandhassa paññāpanāya.
sn22.82:7.9: phasso hetu phasso paccayo saṅkhārakkhandhassa paññāpanāya.
sn22.82:7.10: nāmarūpaṃ hetu nāmarūpaṃ paccayo viññāṇakkhandhassa paññāpanāyāti.
sn22.82:7.11: sādhu bhanteti kho so bhikkhu …pe… apucchi
sn22.82:8.1: kathaṃ nu kho bhante sakkāyadiṭṭhi hotīti.
sn22.82:8.2: idha bhikkhu assutavā puthujjano ariyānaṃ adassāvī ariyadhammassa akovido ariyadhamme avinīto sappurisānaṃ adassāvī sappurisadhammassa akovido sappurisadhamme avinīto
sn22.82:8.3: rūpaṃ attato samanupassati rūpavantaṃ vā attānaṃ attani vā rūpaṃ rūpasmiṃ vā attānaṃ.
sn22.82:8.7: viññāṇaṃ attato samanupassati viññāṇavantaṃ vā attānaṃ attani vā viññāṇaṃ viññāṇasmiṃ vā attānaṃ.
sn22.82:8.9: sādhu bhanteti kho so bhikkhu …pe… apucchi
sn22.82:9.1: kathaṃ pana bhante sakkāyadiṭṭhi na hotīti.
sn22.82:9.2: idha bhikkhu sutavā ariyasāvako ariyānaṃ dassāvī ariyadhammassa kovido ariyadhamme suvinīto sappurisānaṃ dassāvī sappurisadhammassa kovido sappurisadhamme suvinīto
sn22.82:9.3: na rūpaṃ attato samanupassati na rūpavantaṃ vā attānaṃ na attani vā rūpaṃ na rūpasmiṃ vā attānaṃ.
sn22.82:9.7: na viññāṇaṃ attato samanupassati na viññāṇavantaṃ vā attānaṃ na attani vā viññāṇaṃ na viññāṇasmiṃ vā attānaṃ.
sn22.82:9.8: evaṃ kho bhikkhu sakkāyadiṭṭhi na hotīti.
sn22.82:10.1: ko nu kho bhante rūpassa assādo ko ādīnavo kiṃ nissaraṇaṃ.
sn22.82:10.5: ko viññāṇassa assādo ko ādīnavo kiṃ nissaraṇanti.
sn22.82:10.6: yaṃ kho bhikkhu rūpaṃ paṭicca uppajjati sukhaṃ somanassaṃ ayaṃ rūpassa assādo
sn22.82:10.7: yaṃ rūpaṃ aniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāṇadhammaṃ ayaṃ rūpassa ādīnavo
sn22.82:10.8: yo rūpasmiṃ chandarāgavinayo chandarāgappahānaṃ idaṃ rūpassa nissaraṇaṃ.
sn22.82:10.12: yaṃ viññāṇaṃ paṭicca uppajjati sukhaṃ somanassaṃ ayaṃ viññāṇassa assādo
sn22.82:10.13: yaṃ viññāṇaṃ aniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ ayaṃ viññāṇassa ādīnavo
sn22.82:10.14: yo viññāṇasmiṃ chandarāgavinayo chandarāgappahānaṃ idaṃ viññāṇassa nissaraṇanti.
sn22.82:10.15: sādhu bhanteti kho so bhikkhu bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā bhagavantaṃ uttariṃ pañhaṃ apucchi
sn22.82:11.1: kathaṃ nu kho bhante jānato kathaṃ passato imasmiñca saviññāṇake kāye bahiddhā ca sabbanimittesu ahaṅkāramamaṅkāramānānusayā na hontīti.
sn22.82:11.2: yaṅkiñci bhikkhu rūpaṃ atītānāgatapaccuppannaṃ ajjhattaṃ vā bahiddhā vā oḷārikaṃ vā sukhumaṃ vā hīnaṃ vā paṇītaṃ vā yaṃ dūre santike vā sabbaṃ rūpaṃ netaṃ mama nesohamasmi na meso attāti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya passati.
sn22.82:11.6: yaṅkiñci viññāṇaṃ atītānāgatapaccuppannaṃ ajjhattaṃ vā bahiddhā vā oḷārikaṃ vā sukhumaṃ vā hīnaṃ vā paṇītaṃ vā yaṃ dūre santike vā sabbaṃ viññāṇaṃ netaṃ mama nesohamasmi na meso attāti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya passati.
sn22.82:11.7: evaṃ kho bhikkhu jānato evaṃ passato imasmiñca saviññāṇake kāye bahiddhā ca sabbanimittesu ahaṅkāramamaṅkāramānānusayā na hontīti.
sn22.82:12.1: tena kho pana samayena aññatarassa bhikkhuno evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi
sn22.82:12.2: iti kira bho rūpaṃ anattā. vedanā. saññā. saṅkhārā. viññāṇaṃ anattā
sn22.82:12.4: atha kho bhagavā tassa bhikkhuno cetasā cetoparivitakkamaññāya bhikkhū āmantesi
sn22.82:13.1: ṭhānaṃ kho panetaṃ bhikkhave vijjati yaṃ idhekacco moghapuriso avijjāgato taṇhādhigatena cetasā satthu sāsanaṃ atidhāvitabbaṃ maññeyya
sn22.82:13.2: iti kira bho rūpaṃ anattā. vedanā. saññā. saṅkhārā. viññāṇaṃ anattā
sn22.82:13.4: paṭipucchā vinītā kho me tumhe bhikkhave tatra tatra tesu tesu dhammesu
sn22.82:14.9: yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vāti.
sn22.82:14.11: yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ kallaṃ nu taṃ samanupassituṃ
sn22.82:14.12: etaṃ mama esohamasmi eso me attāti.
